mechanism: Cross-panel mechanism reconciliation on overlapping 5-coin FCLR-001 hours: test whether the regime-conditioned funding effect SUPPORTED for RV (FCLR-XSEC-002, HIGH-RV regime, next-hour RV) and for liquidation intensity (FCLR-XSEC-004/005, LOW-RV regime; FCLR-XSEC-006, ALL THREE UTC session buckets, next-hour notional-weighted liquidation intensity) reconciles on the same coin×hour panel by joining FCLR-001 (RV + funding) with the combined liquidation panel (notional-weighted liquidation intensity + funding) on coin x hour.
regime_a_variable: market-wide RV tercile at hour t (computed from FCLR-001 rv24h across the 5 coins); high/mid/low tercile assigned ex-ante per hour
regime_b_variable: UTC trading-session bucket at hour t (Asian [00:00,08:00), European [08:00,16:00), US [16:00,24:00)); bucket assigned ex-ante by clock hour, independent of RV
predictor_primary: abs_fund_pct within-(hour, regime) cross-sectional rank; high_funding = top half of coins by rank, low_funding = bottom half within the same (hour, regime)
outcome_primary_a: next-hour RV per coin = target_rv24h from FCLR-001 panel (shift -1 within coin); FCLR-XSEC-002 estimand restricted to overlapping hours
outcome_primary_b: next-hour NOTIONAL-WEIGHTED observed liquidation intensity per coin = sum of notional_usd over all observed liquidation events of that coin in hour t+1 (shift -1 within coin); DOLLAR SEVERITY, NOT EVENT COUNT; FCLR-XSEC-006 estimand restricted to overlapping hours
baseline_a: within-RV-tercile RV persistence (coin's own rv24h at t split high/low within (hour, tercile)) predicting next-hour RV
baseline_b: within-session-bucket RV persistence (coin's own rv24h at t split high/low within (hour, bucket)) predicting next-hour notional-weighted liquidation intensity
inference: block bootstrap across whole UTC hours within each regime family (seed 20261121, >=2000 deterministic replicates); Holm correction over the joint test family; 2% materiality floor (|mean_diff| / mean_abs_outcome >= 0.02)
joint_test_family: RV-tercile x funding_contrast -> next-hour RV (Primary A)
RV-tercile x rv_persistence_baseline -> next-hour RV (Primary A baseline)
UTC-session-bucket x funding_contrast -> next-hour notional-weighted liq intensity (Primary B)
UTC-session-bucket x rv_persistence_baseline -> next-hour notional-weighted liq intensity (Primary B baseline)
verdict_rule: SUPPORTED only if BOTH primary funding contrasts (Primary A and Primary B) clear all three gates (CI excludes zero, Holm adj_p < 0.05, materiality >= 0.02) on the overlapping hours; otherwise preserve the honest null as NOT_SUPPORTED. Do not threshold-shop; do not relax the 2% floor after seeing outcomes.

cross_panel_reconciliation.description: On the same overlapping coin×hour hours, test whether the same high-abs_fund_pct coins drive both the next-hour RV contrast (Primary A) and the next-hour notional-weighted liquidation intensity contrast (Primary B). Coefficient sign agreement, magnitude correlation of funding-rank effects across the two outcomes, and joint significance.
cross_panel_reconciliation.magnitude_correlation: Pearson/Spearman correlation of per-hour funding-contrast effect sizes between the two outcomes on shared hours
cross_panel_reconciliation.joint_significance: Both primary contrasts individually clear the gate on shared hours

distinct_from: FCLR-STARTER-001 (time-series 24h forward RV forecast, verdict NOT_SUPPORTED)
FCLR-XSEC-001 (pooled within-hour cross-sectional funding contrast on RV, verdict NOT_SUPPORTED)
FCLR-XSEC-002 (regime-conditioned funding contrast on next-hour RV, verdict SUPPORTED — RV-only panel, not joined to liquidation panel)
FCLR-XSEC-003 (thin RV-only holdout, SUPERSEDED, never executed)
FCLR-XSEC-004 (regime-conditioned funding contrast on next-hour liquidation intensity, COUNT-BASED, RV tercile, verdict SUPPORTED — liquidation-only panel, not joined to RV panel)
FCLR-XSEC-005 (regime-conditioned funding contrast on next-hour liquidation intensity, NOTIONAL-WEIGHTED, RV tercile, verdict SUPPORTED — liquidation-only panel, not joined to RV panel)
FCLR-XSEC-006 (UTC-session-bucketed regime-conditioned funding contrast on next-hour notional-weighted liquidation intensity, verdict SUPPORTED — liquidation-only panel, not joined to RV panel)
FCLR-LIQ-COMBINED-PANEL (time-series 24h liquidation intensity QLIKE C2 vs B1, NOT_MET)

constraints.track_separation: observed liquidations (Track A / this campaign) are never conflated with modeled boundary breaches (Track B) or with RV forecasts

cross_reference.fclr_xsec_006_verdict: SUPPORTED (notional-weighted, all three UTC session buckets)
cross_reference.question: does the same high-funding coin set drive both the RV contrast (FCLR-XSEC-002 style) and the notional-weighted liquidation intensity contrast (FCLR-XSEC-006 style) on identical overlapping coin×hour hours
